```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = "")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
})

# ---- paths (all relative to params$base_dir) --------------------------------
P <- function(...) normalizePath(file.path(params$base_dir, ...), mustWork = FALSE)
dirs <- list(
  overlap = "03_outputs/05_overlap",
  topgo   = "03_outputs/06_topGO_supported",
  robust  = "03_outputs/07_robustness",
  heat    = "03_outputs/08_heatmap",
  lineage = "03_outputs/09_lineage_effects"
)

# ---- helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------
rd <- function(rel) {
  f <- P(rel)
  if (file.exists(f)) readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = Inf) else NULL
}

fmt_p <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "", ifelse(x < 1e-3, formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 1),
                              formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)))
}
f_int <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", format(x, big.mark = ","))

show_tab <- function(df, caption, digits = 3, widths = NULL, long = FALSE, font = 8) {
  if (is.null(df)) return(asis_output("\n*Results file not found.*\n"))
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(asis_output("\n*No rows to display.*\n"))
  k <- kable(df, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = long, digits = digits,
             caption = caption, escape = TRUE, linesep = "", row.names = FALSE)
  k <- kable_styling(k, font_size = font, full_width = FALSE,
                     latex_options = if (long) "repeat_header" else c("hold_position", "scale_down"))
  if (!is.null(widths)) {
    for (i in seq_along(widths)) k <- column_spec(k, as.integer(names(widths)[i]), width = widths[[i]])
  }
  k
}

# markdown figure (works for PDF figures with xelatex); notes missing files
md_fig <- function(rel, cap, width = "100%") {
  f <- P(rel)
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(sprintf("\n*Figure not found: `%s`*\n", rel))
  sprintf("\n![%s](%s){width=%s}\n", cap, f, width)
}

# ---- data used in several sections -----------------------------------------------
sup   <- rd(file.path(dirs$robust,  "DE_membership_annotated_supported.csv"))
conc  <- rd(file.path(dirs$robust,  "class_concordance.csv"))
cc    <- rd(file.path(dirs$robust,  "contrast_concordance.csv"))
grid  <- rd(file.path(dirs$lineage, "lineage_threshold_grid.csv"))
pair  <- rd(file.path(dirs$overlap, "pair_concordance.csv"))

n_class <- function(cl) {
  if (is.null(sup)) return(NA_integer_)
  sum(sup$class == cl & sup$support == "supported_both")
}
n_grid <- function(s, p = params$lenient_padj, l = 0) {
  if (is.null(grid)) return(NA_integer_)
  v <- grid$n_total[grid$set == s & abs(grid$padj_cut - p) < 1e-9 & abs(grid$lfc_cut - l) < 1e-9]
  if (length(v)) v[1] else NA_integer_
}
ret <- function(cl) {
  if (is.null(conc)) return(NA_real_)
  v <- conc$pct_frac_retained[conc$class == cl]
  if (length(v)) v[1] else NA_real_
}
pct <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", sprintf("%.0f%%", x))
```

# Key findings

```{r key-findings, results='asis'}
cat("\n")
cat(sprintf(
  "- **Shared stress response.** %s genes are up and %s are down in both the drought and pinoxaden experiments, with the same class under fractional and unique-only counting (lenient tier).\n",
  f_int(n_class("shared_up")), f_int(n_class("shared_down"))))

cat(sprintf(
  "- **Drought-specific response.** %s genes are DE in the drought experiment and clearly not DE in the pinoxaden experiment, and are supported by both counting methods.\n",
  f_int(n_class("drought_specific"))))

if (!is.null(conc)) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "- **Robustness to counting method.** %s of `shared_up` genes and %s of `shared_down` genes in the fractional analysis keep the same class with unique-only counts%s.\n",
    pct(ret("shared_up")), pct(ret("shared_down")),
    if (!is.null(cc)) sprintf("; shrunken log2FCs agree across all contrasts (Spearman rho %.2f to %.2f)",
                              min(cc$rho_lfc, na.rm = TRUE), max(cc$rho_lfc, na.rm = TRUE)) else ""))
}

if (!is.null(pair)) {
  txt <- paste(sprintf("%s: %.0f%% (rho = %.2f)", pair$pair,
                       100 * pair$frac_same_sign_DE, pair$rho_drought_DE), collapse = "; ")
  cat(sprintf(
    "- **Drought vs pinoxaden concordance.** Share of drought-DE genes changing in the same direction in pinoxaden, with Spearman rho of their log2FCs: %s.\n", txt))
}

if (!is.null(grid)) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "- **Lineage effects.** Interaction contrasts (lineage-specific differences in treatment response) called %s and %s genes in the drought experiment (D, H) and %s and %s in the pinoxaden experiment (D, H) at padj < %s. Baseline differences (untreated lineage vs Control) were %s and %s genes in the drought experiment (D, H) and %s and %s in the pinoxaden experiment (D, H).\n",
    f_int(n_grid("DrtInt_D")), f_int(n_grid("DrtInt_H")),
    f_int(n_grid("PinInt_D")), f_int(n_grid("PinInt_H")), params$lenient_padj,
    f_int(n_grid("DrtBase_D")), f_int(n_grid("DrtBase_H")),
    f_int(n_grid("PinBase_D")), f_int(n_grid("PinBase_H"))))
}
```

# Analysis summary

Two experiments were analysed with DESeq2 on 3' QuantSeq counts. The **drought** experiment (144 samples) has lineages C, D and H under well-watered (WW) or drought (DW) conditions. The **pinoxaden** experiment (33 samples) has the same inbred lines (labelled Control, Drought and Herbicide) untreated or treated with pinoxaden. Fold changes were shrunk with `ashr`; adjusted p-values are from the Wald test of the unshrunken estimate. Fractional multimapper-inclusive counts were the primary analysis, with unique-only counts as a sensitivity check.

Two significance tiers were used: **lenient** (padj < `r params$lenient_padj` and absolute log2FC > `r params$lenient_lfc`), used for classification, and **strict** (padj < `r params$strict_padj` and absolute log2FC > `r params$strict_lfc`), used to flag high-confidence genes. A gene was called "clearly not DE" in an experiment if it was tested, padj > `r params$not_de_padj` and absolute log2FC < `r params$not_de_lfc` in every response contrast.

```{r set-table}
sets_desc <- tribble(
  ~Set,        ~Experiment, ~Comparison,
  "Drt_all",   "drought",   "Drought (DW) vs well-watered (WW), all lineages",
  "Drt_D",     "drought",   "D lineage's own DW vs WW response",
  "Drt_H",     "drought",   "H lineage's own DW vs WW response",
  "Pin_all",   "pinoxaden", "Pinoxaden vs untreated, all lines",
  "Pin_D",     "pinoxaden", "Drought line's own pinoxaden response",
  "Pin_H",     "pinoxaden", "Herbicide line's own pinoxaden response",
  "DrtInt_D/H", "drought",  "Interaction: lineage's drought response minus Control's",
  "PinInt_D/H", "pinoxaden","Interaction: line's pinoxaden response minus Control's",
  "DrtBase_D/H", "drought", "Baseline: untreated (WW) lineage vs untreated Control",
  "PinBase_D/H", "pinoxaden","Baseline: untreated line vs untreated Control"
)
show_tab(sets_desc, "Gene sets used in the analysis.", widths = c("3" = "9cm"))
```

```{r class-table}
class_desc <- tribble(
  ~Class,                  ~Definition,
  "shared_up / shared_down", "DE in the same direction in the drought and pinoxaden response contrasts",
  "discordant",            "DE in both experiments, in opposite directions (or mixed)",
  "drought_specific",      "DE in drought; tested and clearly not DE in pinoxaden",
  "pinoxaden_specific",    "DE in pinoxaden; tested and clearly not DE in drought",
  "*_ambiguous_in_*",      "DE in one experiment; tested but neither DE nor clearly null in the other",
  "*_not_tested_in_*",     "DE in one experiment; not tested (filtered or NA padj) in the other",
  "lineage_effects_only",  "DE only in interaction or baseline contrasts"
)
show_tab(class_desc, "Gene classes. Classes use treatment-response contrasts only.", widths = c("2" = "10cm"))
```

```{r top-genes}
if (!is.null(sup)) {
  if (!"interpro" %in% names(sup)) sup$interpro <- NA_character_
  if (!"pfam" %in% names(sup)) sup$pfam <- NA_character_

  top_genes <- sup %>%
    filter(support == "supported_both", class %in% c("shared_up", "shared_down")) %>%
    arrange(class, desc(n_sets_strict), desc(n_sets)) %>%
    group_by(class) %>%
    slice_head(n = params$top_n_genes) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    transmute(
      Gene = gene_id,
      Class = class,
      `Strict sets` = n_sets_strict,
      `DE in` = str_replace_all(sets, "\\+", " + "),
      InterPro = str_trunc(replace_na(interpro, ""), 70),
      Pfam = str_trunc(replace_na(pfam, ""), 40)
    )
} else {
  top_genes <- NULL
}
show_tab(top_genes,
         sprintf("Top %s shared genes per direction, ranked by the number of sets passing the strict tier. The full list is in heatmap_gene_order.csv.",
                 params$top_n_genes),
         widths = c("1" = "3.2cm", "4" = "3.6cm", "5" = "4.5cm", "6" = "2.5cm"),
         long = TRUE, font = 7)
```

# Functional enrichment (topGO)

Enrichment was run on genes supported by both counting methods, against a background of genes tested in the relevant experiment under both methods. `weight01` p-values account for the GO hierarchy but are **not** corrected for multiple testing; `fdr_classic` is the Benjamini-Hochberg FDR of the classic Fisher test.

```{r topgo-summary}
ls_tab <- rd(file.path(dirs$topgo, "list_summary.csv"))
show_tab(ls_tab, "Gene lists tested and annotation coverage.")
```

```{r topgo-top}
tg <- rd(file.path(dirs$topgo, "topGO_supported_all_results.csv"))
focus <- c("shared_up", "shared_down", "drought_specific_up", "drought_specific_down")
if (!is.null(tg)) {
  tg_show <- tg %>%
    filter(ontology == params$topgo_ontology, list %in% focus,
           p_weight01 < 0.05, Significant >= 3) %>%
    group_by(list) %>%
    slice_min(p_weight01, n = params$topgo_top_terms, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    transmute(List = list, `GO ID` = GO.ID, Term = str_trunc(Term, 55),
              `Sig/Annot` = paste0(Significant, "/", Annotated),
              Fold = round(fold, 1),
              `weight01 p` = fmt_p(p_weight01),
              `FDR (classic)` = fmt_p(fdr_classic))
} else tg_show <- NULL
show_tab(tg_show,
         sprintf("Top %s enriched terms per list (ontology %s; weight01 p < 0.05, at least 3 genes).",
                 params$topgo_top_terms, params$topgo_ontology),
         widths = c("3" = "6cm"), font = 7)
```

```{r topgo-dotplot, results='asis'}
cat(md_fig(file.path(dirs$topgo, sprintf("topGO_supported_dotplot_%s.pdf", params$topgo_ontology)),
           sprintf("topGO %s enrichment for supported genes.", params$topgo_ontology)))
```

# Lineage effects of recurrent selection

```{r lineage-grid}
if (!is.null(grid)) {
  g <- grid %>% filter(abs(padj_cut - params$lenient_padj) < 1e-9)
  base_tab <- g %>% filter(lfc_cut == 0) %>%
    transmute(Set = set, Tested = n_tested, Up = n_up, Down = n_down)
  by_lfc <- g %>% filter(lfc_cut %in% c(0, 1, 2)) %>%
    select(Set = set, lfc_cut, n_total) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = lfc_cut, values_from = n_total, names_prefix = "LFC > ")
  grid_show <- left_join(base_tab, by_lfc, by = "Set") %>%
    mutate(Set = factor(Set, levels = c("DrtInt_D", "DrtInt_H", "PinInt_D", "PinInt_H",
                                        "DrtBase_D", "DrtBase_H", "PinBase_D", "PinBase_H"))) %>%
    arrange(Set) %>%
    mutate(Set = as.character(Set))
} else grid_show <- NULL
show_tab(grid_show,
         sprintf("Genes called in each lineage-effect contrast at padj < %s. Up/Down counts have no log2FC filter; the LFC columns give the total at that cutoff.",
                 params$lenient_padj))
```

cat(md_fig(file.path(dirs$overlap, "upset_lenient_lineage_effects_any.pdf"),

} else po_show <- NULL
show_tab(po_show, "Baseline-by-response overlaps with BH-adjusted p < 0.05 (Fisher test).")

# Notes and caveats

- Fold changes are `ashr`-shrunken; padj is from the Wald test against zero, so a gene can be significant with a small shrunken effect, which is why the thresholds combine both.
- `weight01` p-values in the enrichment tables are not multiple-testing corrected; use them to rank terms, and use `fdr_classic` for stricter statements.
- "Drought-specific" and "pinoxaden-specific" depend on the cutoffs for "clearly not DE" (padj > `r params$not_de_padj`, absolute log2FC < `r params$not_de_lfc`). The pinoxaden experiment is smaller (33 samples), so genes that miss significance there may reflect low power.
- Baseline and response contrasts from the same experiment share samples, so their overlaps and correlations are not independent. The cross-experiment pairs are the cleaner test.
- A baseline difference between lines can reflect genetic divergence among the lines, or sequence differences that change read mapping, in addition to selection. A skew toward lower expression in selected lines is what reference-mapping bias would produce.
- Unique-only counting was used as a sensitivity analysis; fractional counting remains the primary analysis.
